# SafeShield Solutions

> SafeShield Solutions measures and installs invisible grills, balcony safety nets, pigeon nets, bird spikes, mosquito nets, cloth hangers, and sports nets for homes and buildings in Raipur and other Chhattisgarh towns. Every job starts with a free site measurement and a written quote; there is no fixed statewide price.

Key facts:
- Service area: Raipur first (Shankar Nagar, Telibandha, VIP Road, Naya Raipur and other localities), then Bhilai, Durg, Bilaspur, Korba and other listed Chhattisgarh towns.
- Steel grade: SS304 is the standard for invisible grills; SS316 is specified only where pool splash or constant damp raises corrosion risk.
- Warranty: five years on installed work, with terms written on the job quote.
- Pricing: depends on measured area, material, floor height, fixing surface and access. Quotes are given after measurement.
- Contact: +91-8977235565, info@safeshieldsolutions.in
